body.intent: Fix Milestone plans running at the same time pick the same milestone number and handle, so the second to merge fails CI self-check with a duplicate handle. Evidence: the agent docs plan (run 01M76EC9, record 01M76ECB) named its intent milestone-32, already held by the cleanup milestone 01M7640B, and failed pr-green-infra on PR #456. I renamed it to milestone-34 by hand (record cs 01M76V0W). The efficient build cycle plan (run 01M76STX, record 01M76SV0) had meanwhile also chosen milestone-34 and failed CI on PR #466 ('duplicate handle: node 01M76NWA... has handle milestone-34, already held by node 01M76XMNA9...'); renamed to milestone-35 by hand (record cs 01M774VK) and resume --retry. Cause: the planner takes the next number from its own branch's model, which can't see other in-flight milestone branches. Fix ideas: the daemon assigns the milestone number when it opens the record change set (counting open milestone records too), or the plan's close-out/rebase renumbers on conflict. The pre-push self-check (01M76R1E) would catch it locally only after merging main.
